1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。” Formula: 所以 + subject + 搬家了；Possessive noun + 的 + family member Correct: “所以，孟子和他的妈妈搬家了。” After introducing 孟子, “他的妈妈” avoids unnecessary repetition and sounds smoother.
